shortDescription: Shares of Chinese data storage products maker Shenzhen Longsys Electronics (9976.HK) are set to open flat at HK$236 in their Hong Kong debut on Tuesday, after the company raised about HK$7.08 billion ($903 million) in its share sale.($1 = 7.8400 Hong Kong dollars)
